title: Survival in the North
partialText: In this chapter of The Call of the Wild, Buck faces the brutal realities of the North. After witnessing Curly’s violent death in a husky pack attack, he learns the ruthless “law of club and fang.” Forced to pull sleds and survive harsh conditions, Buck adapts quickly—stealing food, growing stronger, and awakening his primitive instincts as he transforms from a civilized pet into a hardened sled dog.

title: How to Master Any Skill: Explaining the Biological Shortcut
partialText: Learning isn't about accumulating facts (hard drive model); it's about reducing prediction error in your brain's internal models (schemes). True mastery only "compiles" when you face real-world stakes or deep curiosity that forces your brain to "miss a step" and update. This essay redefines the expert-novice divide and positions AI not as a collaborator, but as a high-velocity extension of your own working memory.

title: Enid's Dream: A Sentient Robot?
partialText: A robot learns to feel. A woman learns to see. And a space colony will never be the same. Enid's story will stay with you.

title: This Journalism Professor Made a Better New York City Chatbot in Minutes: How He Did It
partialText: We caught up with Soma to talk more about how he built his own bot on the fly, and what responsible use of AI—especially for journalists—might look like.

title: Lessons on Reconciliation at Scale With Serverless Architecture
partialText: Reconciliation at scale is the difference between trusting your financial records and spending nights chasing mismatches across multiple parties. At Lead Bank, we build the infrastructure that collects, processes, and reconciles data for card and deposit programs. This post walks through the AWS serverless architecture we built for multi-party reconciliation, the two production bottlenecks we encountered first (file processing limits and Amazon DynamoDB write hot spots), and the patterns we used to mitigate them.

title: Astounding Stories of Super-Science, October, 2022 - Table of Links
partialText: Astounding Stories of Super-Science, October 2022 features Agatha Christie’s classic The Murder of Roger Ackroyd and other compelling stories. From Dr. Sheppard’s breakfast to Poirot’s investigations, the issue explores mystery, suspense, and clever detective work. Now freely available via Project Gutenberg as part of the public domain.

title: Astounding Stories of Super-Science, July, 2008 - Table of Links
partialText: Astounding Stories of Super-Science, July 2008 is a classic sci-fi anthology featuring stories like The Call of the Wild, Into the Primitive, and The Law of Club and Fang. Part of the public domain, this eBook is freely accessible via Project Gutenberg and offers timeless tales of adventure, survival, and the power of nature.

title: The Complete OpenClaw Setup Guide: Install, Configure, and Secure Your AI Gateway
partialText: This guide explains how to install, configure, and secure OpenClaw, a self-hosted gateway that routes messages from platforms like WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord to AI agents capable of running tools and automations. It walks through system requirements, installation methods, onboarding, channel setup, and daily operations, while emphasizing security practices—such as token authentication, loopback binding, and restricted access—to prevent turning your machine into an exposed automation endpoint.

title: The Club and the Law
partialText: In the opening chapter of The Call of the Wild, Buck—once the proud ruler of Judge Miller’s estate—is kidnapped and shipped north during the Klondike Gold Rush. After being brutally beaten by the “man in the red sweater,” Buck learns the harsh rule of survival: the law of the club. This moment marks the start of his transformation from a pampered pet into a hardened sled dog of the wild.

title: Owning Your Identity Online: How Web3 Could Change the Internet
partialText: Web3 aims to give individuals more control over their digital lives. Instead of signing in through a traditional account, users interact with applications through cryptographic wallets. In this model, your identity is not owned by a platform but exists independently on decentralized networks.

title: Is Physical Automation the Next Big Opportunity for AI Startups?
partialText: Physical automation integrates artificial intelligence and hardware to create autonomous machines. Startups can embed machine learning models into robots, sensors, drones and vehicles to unlock new, lucrative applications. Most venture capital investments are being funneled into AI.

title: How AI Companions Impact the Gaming Experience
partialText: AI-powered companions in modern games have several impacts, including forging deeper emotional connections, creating dynamic stories, enhancing gameplay, building personalized experiences, and generating vast and unpredictable worlds.

title: Infrastructure Will Define the Next Internet
partialText: The app-driven internet is hitting structural limits as platforms control data, real-time communication depends on single vendors, and scaling now requires geographic compliance. This article explores how decentralized real-time communication infrastructure (dRTC) changes those tradeoffs by distributing traffic, reducing vendor lock-in, improving resilience, and enabling AI-powered services closer to users.
